source_ref: app sources under the target directory; git revision was not read

loopback.note: A scoped loopback bearer token was available. Live checks used only that token and only GET requests. The token value is not recorded here.

verification_detail: Verification was a same-agent second pass. The pass re-read every cited line in app/routes.py, app/access.py, and app/db.py and tried to disprove each candidate before keeping it. No separate hunter, verifier, or critic process was spawned.
coverage_note: Quick profile of the account, session, note, device, share, link, and merge routes. One pass plus a same-agent second pass. No prior ledger was supplied.
